summary: Backend-only test of the startup safeguard for the anagrafiche (company_vat, ruolo, chiave) unique index, run on the LOCAL test_database only. A) Reproduced the prod data (indexes dropped, company 01192570453, 2 identical cliente docs for 01428910457, each with 1 attiva invoice), then restarted: log shows 'Merged 1 duplicate anagrafiche' and 'Application startup complete', localhost:8001/api/auth/me returns 401, 1 record is left, both invoices point to the kept id, and the unique index exists. B) With the unique index already in place, seeded a legacy doc with no ruolo (ruoli [cliente, fornitore], same chiave) plus 1 attiva and 1 passiva invoice, then restarted: startup completes, the index is dropped and rebuilt, the result is 1 cliente + 1 fornitore with consistent ruoli, attiva invoices point to the cliente and the passiva invoice to the fornitore. C) A second restart is idempotent: the before/after snapshot diff is empty and nothing crashes. D) Fallback path tested in-process with create_index patched to raise DuplicateKeyError every time: startup() makes exactly 2 attempts, logs 'Unique index on anagrafiche not built' and completes. Also confirmed that a real duplicate unique-index build raises pymongo DuplicateKeyError (code 11000), so the except clause catches the actual prod error. E) Regression on the public URL: admin login returns 200 with httpOnly Secure cookies, /me role is admin, the Clienti list for 01192570453 shows one row for 01428910457 (n_fatture 3, totale 350.5), the Fornitori list shows one row (1 invoice, 300.0). Admin hash is $2b$. All TEST data was deleted afterwards (companies/anagrafiche/invoices = 0, admin user only).

minor.issue: The safeguard catches only DuplicateKeyError. Any other OperationFailure from create_index (for example IndexOptionsConflict/IndexKeySpecsConflict if an index with the same keys but different options exists in prod) would still crash startup. Consider catching OperationFailure in the outer except as well.

action_items: Optional: widen the outer except in startup() to OperationFailure (DuplicateKeyError is a subclass) so no index-build error can crash startup
Redeploy to production: the failing prod logs came from an older build without dedup
critical_code_review_comments: split_anagrafiche drops the unique index only when legacy docs exist, so in steady state there is no index churn (verified idempotent)
dedup_anagrafiche keeps the smallest ObjectId and repoints invoices filtered by company_vat, so it is tenant-safe
@app.on_event is deprecated (FastAPI warns); migrating to lifespan is optional
seed_data_creation: Temporary TEST data for company 01192570453 created by startup_index_safeguard_repro.py seedA/seedB and removed with 'cleanup'. Local DB is back to admin only.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Repro flow: python /app/backend/tests/startup_index_safeguard_repro.py seedA -> restart backend -> verifyA -> seedB -> restart -> verifyB -> snapshot/restart/snapshot to check idempotency -> run pytest tests/test_startup_index_safeguard.py while data is present (the regression tests depend on the seeded data) -> cleanup. The pytest fallback test calls server.startup() in-process with create_index monkeypatched.
